 Kerala Lottery Results Today, 24-10-2026 LIVE: Karunya KR-773 Draw Winners List for Prizes Up to Rs 1 Crore
 News oi-Harshika Yadav By Harshika Yadav 
 Updated: Saturday, October 24, 2026, 16:36 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Kerala State Lotteries Department conducted the Karunya KR-773 lottery draw today, Saturday, October 24, 2026, with a first prize of Rs 1 crore. The draw is scheduled for 3 pm at Gorky Bhavan, near Bakery Junction, Thiruvananthapuram. Ticket holders can check the winning numbers and prize details after the results are announced.
 The Karunya KR-773 draw features several prize categories, including Rs 25 lakh for the second prize and Rs 10 lakh for the third prize. A consolation prize of Rs 5,000 is also available for eligible tickets from other series that match the first-prize number. Participants should compare their complete ticket numbers and series with the official result notification before proceeding with a claim.

 The first-prize winner will receive Rs 1 crore, while the second-prize winner will get Rs 25 lakh and the third-prize winner will receive Rs 10 lakh.
 The complete winning-number list, including the smaller prize categories, should be checked against the official notification issued by the Kerala State Lotteries Department.

 Karunya KR-773 Lottery Prize Money: Check All Categories
 The Karunya lottery offers rewards across multiple categories, giving participants opportunities to win prizes beyond the top three awards. The first prize is Rs 1 crore, followed by Rs 25 lakh for the second prize and Rs 10 lakh for the third prize.
 The consolation prize of Rs 5,000 is intended for eligible tickets in other series carrying the first-prize number. The remaining categories offer Rs 5,000, Rs 2,000, Rs 1,000, Rs 500, Rs 200 and Rs 100, respectively.
 The exact winning numbers for each category should be verified through the official result notification. Ticket holders must check both the number and series, wherever applicable, to determine whether their ticket qualifies for a prize.
 How to Check Kerala Karunya KR-773 Lottery Results Online
 Participants can follow these steps to check the Karunya KR-773 result:
 Visit the official Kerala State Lotteries Department website.
 Open the latest results section and locate the Karunya KR-773 draw dated October 24, 2026.
 Open the published result notification or PDF.
 Match the ticket number and series with the relevant prize category.
 Verify the result carefully before beginning the prize claim process.
 Ticket holders should rely on the department's official notification rather than unverified messages or social media posts. The complete result may be published after the draw concludes.
